name: _example
_about: EMPTY on purpose. Copy this folder to clients/<client-name>/ and let DESIGN-INTERVIEW.md fill every value from the client's answers. Every token must be set before the build will run; the build lists anything still empty. What each token means: clients/_example/BRAND.md and the comments in src/shell.html.
_fonts_help: files: [{"src": "clients/<name>/fonts/File.ttf", "weight": "400" or "100 900", "style": "normal" or "italic"}]. Only fonts whose licence allows embedding in video; keep the licence file next to the font.
_grade_help: Optional footage grade: a HyperFrames data-color-grading payload without intensity, e.g. {"preset": "<preset name>", "adjust": {...}}. Leave {} and set --grade-intensity to 0 for ungraded footage. Presets and safe ranges: the HyperFrames color-grading docs.
_cta_help: Defaults for the closing scenes. Image paths are relative to the kit folder, e.g. clients/<name>/logo.png. Leave a value empty to leave it out.
_audio_help: sfx: sound effects on the beats. voiceEq: the presence EQ after DeepFilterNet (turn off for an already-bright voice).
